value.body: VLSI design engineers design and verify the digital and analog circuits inside computer chips. They work in semiconductor companies and chip-design service firms, and the day involves writing hardware description code, running simulations, checking timing and working with other design and verification teams.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Tech in ECE / EEE; M.Tech in VLSI common

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Verilog / SystemVerilog, EDA tools for simulation and synthesis, scripting (Perl, Python, Tcl)

items.label: Common job areas
items.value: RTL design, design verification, physical design, analog layout

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Many entrants have an M.Tech in VLSI or microelectronics, reached through GATE, or take a dedicated VLSI training course after B.Tech. Chip-design firms test digital electronics, Verilog and problem-solving in interviews.

value.title: At a glance
items: Design verification is a common entry area for freshers.
Common next steps: senior design or verification engineer, then lead or architect roles.
Government incentives for chip design and manufacturing are expanding the sector.
